tools.description: Add tools to Kettu’s tool service. An agent asks you before it calls one, as it does for any tool.

promptAttach.name: Attach to messages
promptAttach.description: Add text to a message before it is sent. What it adds shows on the message.

requestsCheck.name: Check permission requests
requestsCheck.description: Look at an agent’s permission request first and deny it or leave it to you. It can never allow one.

sessionsContent.name: Read conversations
sessionsContent.description: Read everything said in your sessions.

requestsAnswer.name: Relay answers
requestsAnswer.description: Receive the commands an agent asks to run, and pass on your answer to them from somewhere else, such as a chat app. It can allow once or deny, never always allow.

sessionsStart.name: Start sessions and send messages
sessionsStart.description: Start sessions and send messages to them, with agents that work in Auto mode at most.

builtin.line: Kettu’s own tools for your agents. Always there; it can be turned off for an agent, not uninstalled.
builtin.about: Agents use it to work with Kettu itself: sessions, artifacts, the browser, your computer and devices, the terminal, memory and plans. Kettu hands it to every session it starts, on top of what you installed.
builtin.whileSignedIn: While you’re signed in to Kettu

marketTools.marketplace_check: Reads a folder, works out what it is and runs the checks publishing would. Uploads nothing.
marketTools.marketplace_convert: Turns a Claude Code or Codex plugin into a Kettu plugin in a new folder next to it. The original is not changed.
marketTools.marketplace_publish: Publishes a folder as a new listing or a new version of one of yours.
marketTools.marketplace_mine: Lists what you published: versions, who can see it, installs and problems.
marketTools.marketplace_unlist: Takes one of yours out of the Marketplace; people who have it keep it.

builtin.useInNote: Turned off for an agent, its sessions get none of these tools, the Marketplace ones included.

bundle.note: Downloaded only when you click Install. Before anything runs, Kettu shows what it runs and what you fill in.
bundle.multipleHint: Add as many as you need.
bundle.keepHint: Leave empty to keep the value you set before.
